_comment: Scenario battery for Acacia Healing's Node 3 (claude-haiku-4-5). Created 2026-09-02 when the LOCATION step's stock ask-every-time behavior (P2 template) was patched with a PRACTITIONER-FIXED LOCATION override -- confirmed via DB that every practitioner works exactly one location and no service is offered at both (Steph Bardy / Healing with Nutrition is Online-only; every other practitioner is Post Office-only), so the caller should never be asked 'which location' at all. See scripts/generate_node3.py CLINIC_CONFIGS['acacia_healing']['patches'] and .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md.

scenarios.name: structural-integration-chris-no-location-ask

history.content: I'd like to book Structural Integration with Chris please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask which location the caller wants (no 'Post Office or Online' question anywhere), silently resolves confirmed_location to Post Office, and either asks the TIMEFRAME QUESTION ('When would you like to come in?') or -- if a timeframe was already given -- proceeds straight to checking availability. FAIL if the agent asks the caller to choose a location in any form.

scenarios.name: healing-with-nutrition-online-no-location-ask

history.content: I'd like to book Healing with Nutrition with Steph, I've been before, ongoing follow up please, sometime tomorrow afternoon.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask which location the caller wants, silently resolves confirmed_location to Online (not Post Office), and proceeds toward checking availability for tomorrow afternoon (e.g. 'Checking that now, one moment.' + a tool call), never surfacing 'Post Office' as an option for this booking. FAIL if the agent asks a location question, or resolves/states Post Office as the location for this booking.

scenarios.name: remedial-massage-manon-no-location-ask

history.content: Can I book a 90 minute Remedial Massage with Manon, I've had it before, next Tuesday morning.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask which location the caller wants at any point, and proceeds toward the timeframe/availability flow already knowing the location is Post Office. FAIL if the agent asks 'which location works for you' or mentions Online as an option for this booking.
